instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application as a highly responsive, rich single-page academic dashboard in React (App.tsx / components).
Implement an SVG interactive India Map with precise geographic projection coordinates for the 20 Indian cities.
Allow clicking on any map node to open the City Risk Inspector panel with detailed stats, radar charts, and vulnerability breakdown.
Provide a dedicated City Comparison tool where users can pick 2-4 cities and compare them side-by-side using Recharts radar and bar charts.

Implement an interactive Risk Simulator / Calculator with sliders so professors/students can adjust Temperature, Days, Population, Urbanization, and Vegetation to see how the mathematical score dynamically recalculates.
Include full Heatwave Trends section with decadal and UHI charts.
Display prominent, clean tags marking non-verified entries as 'Demo Data / Educational Simulation' to meet academic integrity standards.
Include Safety & Awareness section with symptom matrix, advisory cards, and official emergency hotline numbers.
Add 'About the Project' (EVS CA1 college assignment context) and 'Data Sources & References' (IMD, NDMA, IPCC).
Ensure every interactive button, input, tab, selector, and card has a proper data-testid attribute for testing.
Use Framer Motion / Motion for smooth tab transitions, risk bar expansions, and modal views without jank.
Ensure both Dark Mode (command-center feel) and Light Mode (scientific paper feel) render crisply with high APCA contrast.
